description: Writes a ready-to-save Claude Code slash command file with frontmatter, $ARGUMENTS and a step outline. Returns { path, content, usage }: save content at path (.claude/commands/<name>.md). Price: 1 credit (1 credit = 1 CAD cent) per successful call; input that does not match the schema is rejected before billing.

allowedTools.description: Optional tool rules the command may use, e.g. Read or Bash(git diff:*).

argumentHint.description: Optional hint for the arguments, e.g. [file] [focus].

description.description: One-line description shown in the / menu.

name.description: Command name: lowercase letters, digits and -, up to 40 characters.
